nodes.description: Address of the contract admin, set to msg.sender in the constructor and minted the initial supply.
Mapping of account balances; mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances; mutated by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the CHBToken constructor via _setupDecimals.
Constructor: assigns _admin = msg.sender, sets decimals to 18 and mints the initial 100e18 supply. The 'minter' argument is ignored.
Public function that burns the caller's tokens and emits TransferToNative for a native-chain bridge transfer.
External view function that only requires blockNumber < block.number and returns nothing else; block.number/timestamp style dependency with no return value.
Internal burn routine: subtracts from _balances[account] and from _totalSupply, emitting a Transfer to address(0).
Internal mint routine: adds to _totalSupply and _balances[account], emitting a Transfer from address(0).
Internal transfer routine moving amount from sender to recipient in _balances.
Public ERC20 transfer that forwards _msgSender() balance to recipient.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements the allowance of _msgSender().
Internal helper returning msg.sender, used as the effective caller throughout the token logic.
Attacker-controlled caller; becomes _admin in the constructor and is the burned account in transferToNative.
State-changing burn of the caller's balance with no allowance or authorization check, executed before the event is emitted.
Unchecked privileged mint of the entire initial supply 100000000000000000000 to _admin (the deployer).
Constructor argument 'minter', documented as the multi-sig address but never used in the body.
Destination identifier on the native chain, only used in the TransferToNative event.
Amount of CHBF to burn; flows directly into _burn.
Account argument of getPriorVotes; unused in the body.
Block number argument compared against block.number by the require statement.
Account whose balance is reduced by the burn.
Amount removed from the account balance and from the total supply.
Recipient of newly minted tokens.
Amount added to the total supply and to the recipient balance.
Debited account in the internal transfer.
Credited account in the internal transfer.
Amount moved between the two balances.
Public transfer destination.
Public transfer amount, funded by the caller balance.
Account whose allowance is decremented and whose balance is debited.
Account credited by transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom and subtracted from the allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into _admin during construction, so the deployer gains admin/owner privileges.
msg.sender determines whose balance transferToNative burns, so the caller controls the burned account.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the debited account.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
Constructor writes the deployer address into the _admin state variable.
Constructor calls _setupDecimals(18), writing the _decimals state variable.
Constructor executes the privileged mint of the whole initial supply to _admin.
transferToNative performs the burn of the caller balance as its first state-changing operation.
transferToNative directly invokes the internal _burn routine.
_burn decrements _balances[account].
_burn decrements _totalSupply.
Constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
_mint increments _totalSupply.
_mint credits _balances[account].
transfer delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the _allowances mapping of the spender.
_transfer debits and credits entries in _balances.
transfer obtains the caller through _msgSender().
transferFrom obtains the caller through _msgSender().
_msgSender returns msg.sender, exposing the untrusted caller to calling functions.
The minter constructor argument is declared but never read, while _admin is taken from msg.sender instead.
The 'to' argument is embedded into the TransferToNative event emitted by transferToNative.
The 'value' argument drives the burn amount and the emitted event value in transferToNative.
The 'value' argument is passed as the amount burned by _burn.
The account argument is accepted by getPriorVotes but never used.
The blockNumber argument feeds the require(blockNumber < block.number) check in getPriorVotes.
The account argument selects the balance entry decremented by _burn.
The amount argument determines how much balance and supply _burn removes.
The account argument selects the balance entry credited by _mint.
The amount argument is added to supply and balance by _mint.
The sender argument is the debited account inside _transfer.
The recipient argument is the credited account inside _transfer.
The amount argument is the value moved by _transfer.
The recipient argument is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
The amount argument is forwarded from transfer into _transfer.
The sender argument is used by transferFrom for both the transfer and the allowance subtraction.
The recipient argument is forwarded from transferFrom into _transfer.
The amount argument is subtracted from the allowance and forwarded to _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: Function argument that is never used; it belongs to the constructor signature and is absorbed into the constructor core node.
Local function argument only used to build the event payload of transferToNative.
Argument passed straight into the burn invoked by transferToNative.
Unused argument declared in the getPriorVotes signature.
Argument consumed only by the require guard inside getPriorVotes.
Parameter used solely to index the balance mapping mutated by _burn.
Parameter representing the quantity removed by _burn.
Parameter representing the mint beneficiary inside _mint.
Parameter representing the minted quantity inside _mint.
Parameter identifying the debited side of the internal transfer.
Parameter identifying the credited side of the internal transfer.
Parameter representing the moved value in _transfer.
Parameter forwarded from the public transfer entry point into _transfer.
Parameter forwarded from the public transfer entry point into _transfer.
Parameter used by transferFrom for the allowance and balance update.
Parameter used for the allowance subtraction and the delegated transfer.
